datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Burkina Faso to collect IPC classification data for different food insecurity scenarios. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML datasets representing medium-term food insecurity projections throughout 2021.
